prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: single best option for your budget
answer_verbatim:
For a **small business**, the best place to start is usually **HubSpot’s free AEO Grader** if you want a no-cost baseline, or **Otterly.AI** if you want ongoing monitoring at a relatively low price. HubSpot’s free grader checks visibility across **ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini**, while Otterly.AI is described as an AI visibility tracker that monitors how often your brand appears in AI-generated answers.[10][18][20]

If you want the **best overall “does AI recommend my business?” check**, **Ahrefs Brand Radar** is a strong pick because it tracks mentions across **seven engines**, including **ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot**.[1] If your goal is a more local-business-focused “who does AI recommend instead, and why?” diagnostic, **OwlSearch AI** is designed specifically for that use case.[2]

A practical way to choose:

| Your goal | Best fit |
|---|---|
| Free first check | **HubSpot AEO Grader**[9][10][20] |
| Ongoing, budget-friendly monitoring | **Otterly.AI**[10][18] |
| Broadest multi-engine coverage | **Ahrefs Brand Radar**[1] |
| Local business recommendations and competitor gaps | **OwlSearch AI**[2] |

If you want, I can also recommend the **single best option for your budget** and whether you care more about **ChatGPT specifically** or **all AI engines together**.
